body_html:
Are there any #ds106 heads who haven't tried #indieweb plug-ins on their WordPress site but were always curious?

I am recruiting participants who would do a "cognitive lab" while installing the program. Think about reading "think alouds" I ask you to verbalize your decisions as you set up the #indieweb plug-in and verbalize any issues you may have through the process.
